actions.action: Gently remove loose debris from the hole with a dry cotton swab or soft brush
Keep the damaged spot dry for about a week so it calluses
If trimming anything, sterilize tools with 70% isopropyl alcohol
Monitor the wound for 1–2 weeks for soft, dark, water-soaked tissue, sour smell or new spots
Acclimate the plant gradually before moving it outdoors
Identify the species and share a whole-plant photo for a more confident answer
